name: beauticode
description: Local image/video backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness (also Codex Desktop). Unofficial.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @beauticode/core && npm run build -w @beauticode/adapter-codex && npm run build -w @beauticode/adapter-dsh && npm run build -w @beauticode/adapter-workbuddy
scripts.test: npm run test -w @beauticode/core && npm run test -w @beauticode/adapter-codex && npm run test -w @beauticode/adapter-dsh && npm run test -w @beauticode/adapter-workbuddy
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @beauticode/core && npm run typecheck -w @beauticode/adapter-codex && npm run typecheck -w @beauticode/adapter-dsh && npm run typecheck -w @beauticode/adapter-workbuddy
scripts.tray: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/tray/start-tray.ps1 -SkipBuild
